scope: All Disc 1 non-battle environment backgrounds, in first-visit story order
remainingOrder: Production review order is recorded separately; uncertain variant first visits require transition evidence during deferred testing. Numeric cut order is not story order.

screens.name: Seles commander square
screens.orderEvidence: Cut 10 player script transitions to cut 725 entrance 6 before global flag 2 0x281 is set; runtime sequence reaches commander battle.

screens.name: Seles village square
screens.orderEvidence: Cut 725 post-battle script transitions to cut 12 entrance 18; recorded walking route exits to cut 742.

screens.name: Hellena Prison distant overlook
screens.orderEvidence: Actual cut 12 northern-exit recording transitions to cut 742, whose title identifies Hellena Prison; cut 742 transitions to 694.

screens.name: Shana's prison cell
screens.orderEvidence: Actual cut 742 transition to cut 694; original cell recording exits to cut 695.

screens.name: Hellena cavern hall
screens.orderEvidence: Actual cut 694 transition to cut 695; hall returns to world-map engine.

screens.name: Forest entrance from Seles
screens.orderEvidence: World-map path 2 connects Seles to forest cut 624 entrance 10; recorded walk exits to cut 5.

screens.name: Forest ravine and fallen tree
screens.orderEvidence: Actual cut 624 route exits to cut 5 entrance 14; recorded ravine crossing exits to cut 625 after 419 frames.

screens.name: Forest maze
screens.orderEvidence: Actual cut 5 route enters 625 at entrance 20; verified 843-frame route with both scripted jumps exits to cut 6.

screens.name: Forest vine ravine
screens.orderEvidence: Verified 1643-frame crossing and childhood flashback from entrance 17 exits to cut 7.

screens.name: Forest exit trail
screens.orderEvidence: Verified 433-frame walk from cut 6 entrance 1 to the world-map engine.

screens.name: Hellena Prison approach
screens.orderEvidence: World-map arrival at entrance 16; verified 2431-frame flyover and cart sequence exits to cut 14 entrance 1.
screens.additionalVerification: Escape arrival from cut 56 entrance 14 through world-map exit: 289 matching frames and 1156 samples. Initial arrival input disabled for this return route.

screens.name: Hellena cliffside entrance
screens.orderEvidence: Verified 2419-frame cart boarding and drawbridge crossing from entrance 1 exits to cut 37 entrance 0.

screens.name: Hellena entrance hall
screens.orderEvidence: Verified 484-frame cart arrival from entrance 0 exits to cut 16 entrance 9; all 6292 foreground samples match.

screens.name: Hellena storeroom
screens.orderEvidence: Verified 1698-frame arrival and original-floor traversal from entrance 9 reaches the scripted guard battle; all 15282 foreground samples match.
screens.additionalVerification: Post-encounter entrance 21: 1239 matching frames and 11151 layer samples; exits to cut 15 via original stair transition. Rear-exit entrance 24: 1587 matching frames and 14283 layer samples, exits cut 19 entrance 15; actual captures inspected.

screens.name: Hellena lower hall
screens.orderEvidence: First visit from cut 16 uses entrance 4; 262 matching frames and 3406 layer samples through the lower-floor guard encounter. Guard state at battle: 46=false, 47=true.
screens.additionalVerification: Separate upper-walkway entrance 45: 197 matching frames, exits to cut 23 entrance 23. Recorded under cut-15-upper-walkway. Post-encounter entrance 3 with recorded guard47=true: 195 matching frames, 2535 layer samples; exits to cut 17 entrance 11. Eastern passage from entrance 4: 413 matching frames, 5369 samples; exits cut 23 entrance 0. Return hall: 411 matching frames and 5343 samples to cut 16 entrance 24. Rescued-party Fruegel confrontation: 1656 matching frames and 21528 samples to battle. The separate escape-hall walk checks free traversal, not this story variant. Fruegel aftermath: 819 matching frames and 10647 samples to cut 56 entrance 6.

screens.name: Hellena lift cavern
screens.orderEvidence: Verified 1049-frame walk, failed lift ascent, and return through original arches; 10490 matching layer samples; exits to cut 15 entrance 11.

screens.name: Hellena vertical stairwell
screens.orderEvidence: Verified eastern passage from cut 15 reaches entrance 0. First-visit guard encounter: 220 matching frames, 2420 samples.
screens.additionalVerification: Post-guard48 visit from entrance 0: 535 matching frames and 5885 layer samples; scripted climb and upper stairs exit to cut 20 entrance 22. Earlier upper storage spur remains under cut-23-storage-spur. Escape descent: 491 matching frames and 5401 samples to cut 15 entrance 33.

screens.name: Hellena bridge stairwell
screens.orderEvidence: Rear doorway from cut 16 enters at 15. Verified 249 frames and 3237 layer samples through chest approach and return to cut 16 entrance 10. Upper stairs and bridge traversal await their later story visit.

screens.name: Hellena suspended platforms
screens.orderEvidence: From cut 23 to entrance 22; 365 matching frames and 5840 layer samples across the lower bridge and platform to cut 21 entrance 28. Upper platforms remain for subsequent visits.
screens.additionalVerification: Lower basket ascent: 795 matching frames and 12720 samples to cut 25. Tower guard encounter: 232 matching frames and 3712 samples through battle transition. Upper basket and bridge to key hall: 723 matching frames and 11568 samples to cut 31 entrance 0. Locked-door approach is reserved for the subsequent key-return route. Key return from entrance 20: 403 identical frames and 6448 layer samples through door unlock and transition to cut 28 entrance 4. Descending upper basket from entrance 0 to cut 25 entrance 18: 691 matching frames and 11056 samples, including full camera travel. Lower basket descent from entrance 7: 831 matching frames and 13296 samples to cut 23 entrance 20.

screens.name: Hellena furnace rest room
screens.orderEvidence: From cut 20 entrance 28; 656 matching frames and 13776 layer samples through ladder descent, outer walkway and guard encounter. Remaining post-encounter traversal is pending.

screens.name: Hellena tower landing
screens.orderEvidence: Basket ascent reaches entrance 18. Scripted arrival: 172 matching frames and 2236 layer samples, exits cut 24 entrance 0. Bridge artwork corrected against original reference; later free-walking visit remains pending.
screens.additionalVerification: Tower return from entrance 18 to cut 24 entrance 2: 199 matching frames and 2587 samples. Return from entrance 33: 195 matching frames and 2535 samples to cut 20 entrance 7.

screens.name: Hellena Lavitz encounter
screens.orderEvidence: Scripted transition from cut 25. Initial Lavitz sequence: 3567 matching frames and 53505 layer samples through battle handoff. Post-battle conversation and walk to cut 26 entrance 2: 2927 matching frames and 43905 layer samples.
screens.additionalVerification: Side-cell door from entrance 2 to cut 640 entrance 0: 177 identical frames and 2655 layer samples. Separate recess beneath foreground 6. All changed background pixels are fully covered by the original opaque door when closed. Return from the side cell: 179 matching frames and 2685 samples to cut 25 entrance 33.

screens.name: Hellena cell corridor
screens.orderEvidence: Lavitz post-battle exit enters at 2. Verified 169 frames and 2704 foreground samples through the right door opening and exit to cut 642 entrance 1. Separate open-door underlay supports original overlays 5 and 13.
screens.additionalVerification: Second door route from entrance 15: 209 matching frames and 3344 layer samples to cut 641 entrance 2. Tower exit from entrance 0: 187 matching frames and 2992 layer samples to cut 25 entrance 2. Both door openings and upper corridor traversal checked in gameplay; lower bridge route remains for later review.

screens.name: Hellena prisoner workroom
screens.orderEvidence: Cut 26 right door leads to entrance 1. Walking route around prisoners and bench returns to cut 26 entrance 15 in 321 identical frames and 1605 layer samples. Original extra edge column retained in 1540x1024 canvases.

screens.name: Hellena crate room
screens.orderEvidence: Second corridor door leads to entrance 2. Verified 485 frames and 3880 layer samples through original automatic crate jumps, chest approach and return to cut 26. Crate heights corrected against actual gameplay before acceptance; initial version retained as reference.

screens.name: Hellena central cavern hall
screens.orderEvidence: Upper bridge from cut 20 enters at 0. Full key conversation and return to cut 20 entrance 20 verified: 2207 identical frames and 37519 layer samples. Original 17 masks retained; all layers remain fixed and visible. Stair, bridge and lower-floor footing checked in actual gameplay.

screens.name: Hellena upper cell gallery
screens.orderEvidence: Key-return route from cut 20 enters at 4. Verified upper walkway to cut 29 entrance 0: 199 matching frames and 2587 layer samples. Generated extra props removed before installation. Lower bridge and passage variants remain for later visits.
screens.additionalVerification: Lower gallery and stairs from entrance 21 to cut 20 entrance 0: 227 matching frames and 2951 samples.

screens.name: Hellena inner cell corridor
screens.orderEvidence: Cut 28 upper walkway leads to entrance 0. Side-room approach and opening door verified through cut 644 entrance 0: 171 identical frames and 2736 layer samples. Separate recess under foreground 5 preserves the disappearing door. Guard and bridge routes remain for later review.
screens.additionalVerification: Return from the storage room at entrance 1 to cut 27 entrance 2: 241 identical frames and 3856 layer samples, with normal guard movement active. Lower walkway from entrance 13 to cut 28 entrance 21: 167 matching frames and 2672 samples.

screens.name: Hellena timber storage room
screens.orderEvidence: Inner corridor side door leads to entrance 0. Walk around prisoners and behind foreground beams, chest approach and return to cut 29 entrance 1: 239 identical frames and 717 layer samples. All three original foreground masks retained.

screens.name: Hellena rescue cell block
screens.orderEvidence: Inner corridor leads to entrance 2. Guard confrontation: 234 identical frames and 3744 layer samples. Post-battle cell opening: 587 identical frames and 9392 samples through cut 643 entrance 0. Separate recess artwork under original door masks 6 and 13; final opening occurs during the original fade.
screens.additionalVerification: Escape conversation after the second guard battle: 2003 identical frames and 32048 layer samples through cut 22 entrance 0. Second guard encounter verified from the initialized scripted pose: 242 identical frames and 3872 samples. Lower-bridge return from entrance 39 to cut 29 entrance 13: 257 identical frames and 4112 samples.

screens.name: Hellena Shana reunion cell
screens.orderEvidence: Cell opening from cut 27 leads to entrance 0. Full reunion and departure: 2017 identical frames and 4034 layer samples through cut 27 entrance 2. Original RGBA textures are identical to cut 694; its modern master is reused with independently validated original masks and actual reunion captures.

screens.name: Hellena commander escape interlude
screens.orderEvidence: Escape conversation from cut 27 leads to entrance 0. Fruegel interlude and return to cut 27 entrance 26: 1471 identical frames and 25007 samples. All 18 original RGBA textures match cut 695, allowing consistent reuse of its modern artwork. Capture anchors after the original layer depth flags initialize.

screens.name: Hellena wheel and barrel storehouse
screens.orderEvidence: Second rescue-block door leads to entrance 0. Full clear-aisle traversal around prisoner, chest approach and return to cut 27 entrance 39: 299 identical frames and 598 foreground samples. Original chest and NPC collisions retained; both original foreground masks exact.

screens.name: Hellena skeleton side cell
screens.orderEvidence: Optional side cell reached on the escape return through cut 24. Full floor traversal and return to cut 24 entrance 14: 249 identical frames and 498 foreground samples. Original skeleton model and both exact foreground masks retained.

screens.name: Hellena drawbridge escape
screens.orderEvidence: After Fruegel aftermath, entrance 6. Complete drawbridge escape: 1519 matching frames and 4557 samples to cut 13 entrance 14. All four original RGBA textures exactly match cut 14; reused its modern master with independent masks and gameplay verification.

screens.name: Prairie coastal chase
screens.orderEvidence: World-map entry 4 after Hellena. Full arrival, coastal path walk, pursuit and cliff sequence: 2931 identical frames and 20517 foreground samples to cut 39 entrance 3. All seven foreground masks exact; first scripted pose anchors the comparison.

screens.name: Prairie tree crossroads
screens.orderEvidence: Entry 3 from coastal chase. Complete hiding, guard search, party reunion and path to river: 2579 identical frames and 28369 layer samples to cut 43 entrance 6. Eleven exact stationary foreground masks; camera anchor (-128,-72).

screens.name: Prairie river crossing
screens.orderEvidence: First visit from entrance 6: blocked crossing conversation and return to cut 39 entrance 33. 293 identical frames and 1172 foreground samples. Four exact masks; original animated water retained. Full log crossing also verified: 773 matching frames / 3092 samples to cut 44 entrance 20.

screens.name: Prairie farmyard
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 5 from crossroads. Full party arrival conversation and path up the left steps to cut 42 entrance 0: 1343 identical frames and 10744 samples. Eight exact fixed masks; original horse remains a separate model.

screens.name: Prairie cliff and fallen-tree puzzle
screens.orderEvidence: First visit from farmyard entrance 0, after blocked river. Tree inspection dialogue and return to cut 40 entrance 24: 553 identical frames and samples. Stump alignment revised after viewing original animated tree; original model retained. Full axe sequence also verified: 1953 identical frames and samples; original tree animation and exposed stump inspected.

screens.name: Prairie shed and axe search
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 1 after tree inspection. Complete party conversation and axe search, return to cut 40 entrance 15: 3949 identical frames / 35541 samples. Original nine masks retained; layers 7/8 disappear during search. Continuous underlay plus prop rebuilt against original outline; mask-edge RGB blends into floor without changing alpha.

screens.name: Prairie exit and refugee family
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 20 after log crossing. Full refugee family conversation and departure to world map: 2527 identical frames / 17689 layer samples. Seven exact stationary foreground masks, full-canvas 2560x1024 pack; original water animation retained.

screens.name: Cave entrance and sea arch
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 0 from world map. Upper path, central bridge and left-hand descent to cut 46: 491 identical frames / 2455 samples. Five exact stationary masks; original animated water retained.

screens.name: Cavern waterfall and sliding paths
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 8 from cave entrance. Main descent: 423 identical frames / 7191 samples to cut 47 entrance 12. Full sliding path and return to exit: 631 frames / 10727 samples. Seventeen exact masks; capture starts after foreground 1 depth 33042 initializes. Original waterfall and animated sliding effects retained.

screens.name: Cave stepping stones and party crossing
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 12 from waterfall cavern. Complete party crossing and landing sequence to cut 48 entrance 37: 3283 identical frames / 6566 samples. Two exact masks. Shore and stone positions revised twice after in-game checks; original animated water and character actions retained.

screens.name: Cave raised platforms and healing spring
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 37 after stepping stones. Full healing-spring interaction, party conversation and exit to cut 49 entrance 38: 3259 identical frames / 6518 samples. Two exact stationary masks; camera anchor (128,72). Original ambient effects retained.

screens.name: Cave stairway and terraced pools
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 38 after healing spring. Terraced pools and central stairway to cut 50 entrance 4: 451 identical frames / 2255 samples. Five exact stationary masks; full-canvas 1536x2048 pack. Upper-exit return from cut 50: 607 identical frames / 3035 samples to cut 51 entrance 10, including original scripted jump.

screens.name: Cave jumping stones and flying creature
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 4 from stairway. Outer jumping route, treasure approach and return to cut 49 entrance 45: 779 identical frames / 3895 samples. Five exact masks; full-canvas 1536x1024 pack. Original flying creature and mist retained. Upper islands and creature encounters are not covered by this route.

screens.name: Cave stone bridge and illuminated arch
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 10 from upper stairway. Complete stone path to cut 52 entrance 33: 279 identical frames and layer samples. One exact mask; 1536x1024 pack. Stone tops lowered after an in-game footing review; original mist retained. Capture waits for foreground depth flag 16384.

screens.name: Cave main chamber and central pillar
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 33 from stone bridge. Full left-side path, bridge and central-pillar route to cut 53 entrance 2: 541 identical frames / 5410 samples. Ten exact stationary masks; 2048x1028 pack preserves original 512x257 bounds. Original save-point and water effects retained.

screens.name: Cave guardian chamber and party recovery
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 2 from main cavern. Full boss introduction: 1134 identical frames / 7938 samples to Battle. Post-battle party recovery and exit: 1223 frames / 8561 samples to cut 54 entrance 34. Seven exact masks; 1536x1024 pack. Original creatures, party and effects retained.

screens.name: Cave winding exit
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 34 after guardian chamber. Winding ascent and world-map exit: 715 identical frames / 5005 samples. Seven exact stationary masks; 1536x2048 full-canvas pack. Original cutaway silhouettes retained. Capture waits for the initialized camera around y=-118.7; random encounters disabled only in the capture fixture.

screens.name: Bale fountain square and arrival
screens.orderEvidence: World-map entrance 40. Full arrival camera sequence and left route to market square cut 69 entrance 20: 819 identical frames / 13923 samples. Seventeen exact stationary masks; 2048x1536 pack. Original townspeople, birds, fountain animation and smoke retained. Capture begins at camera (64,-72). Other square exits remain to be recorded.

screens.name: Bale market square
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 20 from cut 66. Route to tower exterior cut 86 entrance 3: 393 identical frames / 6288 layer samples. Sixteen exact stationary masks; 2560x1536 pack. Capture anchor (-74,-72) excludes camera initialization; exact comparator unchanged. Other exits remain unverified.

screens.name: Bale fortified tower exterior
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 3 from market square. Stair ascent to cut 91 entrance 0: 489 identical frames / 5868 samples. Lower doorway to cut 90 entrance 1: 301 identical frames / 3612 samples. Twelve exact stationary masks, 1536x1536 pack. Both thresholds and stair footing visually inspected. Initial source and built-in ImageGen alignment revision retained.
screens.additionalVerification: One modern stair attempt differed only in player position for three frames; a repeat matched exactly without changing the comparator or route. Right-hand return route and later variants remain unrecorded. Basement return entrance 7 to market cut 69 entrance 8: 293 identical frames / 3516 samples, actual captures checked.

screens.name: Bale tower residential interior
screens.orderEvidence: Upper tower door enters at 0. Central hall and stairs to cut 92 entrance 11: 213 identical frames / 4260 layer samples. Twenty exact stationary masks, full-canvas 2560x1536 pack. Actual game frames 120, 180 and 210 inspected. Camera begins at (0,-72). Side rooms and subsequent story variants remain unrecorded.

screens.name: Bale upper tower audience chamber
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 11 from cut 91. Central stair and left chamber approach return to cut 91 entrance 49: 463 identical frames / 8797 samples. Nineteen exact masks; 2560x1536 pack. Layer 1 remains hidden in this trace; use the dedicated cut-92 packager. Stair footing and left chamber captures inspected.
screens.additionalVerification: The initial extended route was blocked by the NPC at the top of the spiral stairs and timed out. The revised route approaches the chamber and returns through the clear path. NPC conversation, other rooms and later story variants remain unrecorded.

screens.name: Bale tower dragon-research basement
screens.orderEvidence: Entrance 1 from cut 86 lower door. Left corridor/storage stairs to cut 91 entrance 35: 393 identical frames / 7467 samples. Laboratory passage to cut 86 entrance 7: 449 frames / 8531 samples. Nineteen exact stationary masks; 2560x1536 pack. Original dragon, guards, lighting/effect models retained. Stair support and painting placement revised from paired actual-game captures.
screens.additionalVerification: Basement test input updates only on script ticks to avoid SDL key timing differences at stairs. Initial interaction-wait route was stopped while stuck; an early right route timed out at a fixture. The passing right route detours around it. Initial master and all built-in revision prompts/sources retained. Other basement interactions and ladder routes remain unrecorded.
